newsitem.title: GREECE: TIGHT T+2 SETTLEMENT RULE HAS TELESIS OUT OF TRADE.
newsitem.headline: TIGHT T+2 SETTLEMENT RULE HAS TELESIS OUT OF TRADE.

text.p: Athens stock exchange member Telesis Securities was not allowed to trade during Thursday's session because of a tight trade-plus-two settlement rule which has caused repeated problems with other Greek brokers as well.

"There was the usual settlement problem. We didn't meet the deadline on delivery of shares as one of the custodians was late. There has to be an official extension to T+3, otherwise the problem will remain," said Telesis Securities managing director Victor Asser.
Athens brokers who do a large amount of business with foreign investors have faced problems meeting the 48-hour settlement regulation.

Frequently the global custodian-local custodian-broker chain practically runs out of time with the clearing house's deadline. Other firms have faced the same problem recently and were not allowed to trade for a day. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
